title: ETHREUM L1 DOES NOT NEED L2s?
subTitle:
I analyzed this three years ago, at that time the market still had great faith in L2s, currently out of 135 existing Layer 2s, 109 L2s have less than 1 user operation per second.
- Recently, Vitalik outlined a shift in focus from 'L2 as a salvation for L1' to 'L1 self-reinforcement and L2 specialization', a significant filtering for current L2s and opening the way for L1.
1. The obsolescence of the old 'Rollup-centric vision' of L2s.
- L2s have not progressed to Stage 2 (the fully decentralized stage, without human intervention) as quickly as expected.
- Ethereum L1 is no longer stagnant. With a strong roadmap for increasing the Gas limit in 2026 and current low costs, L1 is directly taking on part of the expansion role that was previously reserved for L2.
- L2s operate like separate 'islands', disrupting user experience and fragmenting liquidity.
2. Fundamental changes and a new vision.
- L1 is not just a data availability layer but also a proof verification layer through Native ZK-EVM Precompile. L1 will increase the Gas limit to handle more transactions.
- L2 should stop acting as a 'copy' of L1. L2 needs to specialize (AI, Privacy, High-speed) and must reach at least Stage 1 to ensure asset safety.
- L2s will operate as a unified cluster instead of discrete chains using Native Rollup Precompile, opening up the possibility of Synchronous Composability.
- Integrate ZK-EVM authentication into the protocol, eliminating the need for Security Councils, making L2 truly decentralized and automatically upgrading according to L1.
3. The goal is directed towards
- L1 directly scales to handle core value, serving as the highest security layer.
- L2 provides a variety of features and super high performance, experimenting with new features, high-risk, or specialized.
- The real-time ZK proof system binds everything together into a single global computer, where transactions occur instantaneously and synchronously across all shards.
4. Personal conclusion
- Recently we have seen$ETH becoming faster and cheaper, many L2s that were created have proven to be 'unnecessary' now.
- Some L2s develop based on themselves like Base, opBNB,... they use ETH as a platform to build a lightweight version of their L1, so they can continue to survive.
- L2s built on trends will be heavily filtered.
- The future of the ETH base network (Layer 1) is being focused on and developed more strongly. Next season$ETH will return to the star position.
- What do you think?
#ETH

title: Why Did ETH Suddenly Pump? Not Random — Here’s What Really Happened
subTitle:
Ethereum just ripped higher after a brutal sell-off… and this move was driven by liquidity + technical exhaustion + market-wide relief, not blind hype.
Let’s unpack it 👇
💥 1) Massive Liquidity Grab Near $1,750
From the chart:
ETH nuked into the $1,750–1,800 zone
That’s a major historical demand area
Long lower wick = buyers absorbed panic selling
Stops + liquidations below support were cleared first
Classic playbook:
📉 Flush weak hands → 🐳 Smart money buys → 📈 Fast rebound.
📊 2) Deep Oversold = Snap-Back Rally
ETH was:
Far below short-term moving averages
Likely RSI oversold
Heavy red candles followed by strong green = seller exhaustion
When selling pressure dries up, even moderate buying causes explosive candles.
🐋 3) Short Squeeze Added Rocket Fuel
After that crash:
Traders piled into shorts
Bounce triggered forced buy-backs
Liquidations = instant market orders → vertical candles
That’s why the recovery felt so violent.
🌊 4) Bitcoin Stabilized → Alts Catch a Bid
ETH rarely pumps alone:
BTC bounced from its own major support
Market fear cooled
Capital rotated into large-cap alts
ETH is always one of the first beneficiaries in relief phases.
🧠 5) Structure Reset — But Trend Still Cautious
Let’s be real:
ETH is still below major moving averages on higher timeframes.
So right now this looks like:
⚠️ A powerful relief rally inside a broader corrective structure —
not yet a confirmed macro reversal.
📍 Levels Everyone Should Watch
🔵 Support:
• $1,950–1,900
• $1,750 (critical floor)
🔴 Resistance:
• $2,200–2,350
• $2,700+
Only strong acceptance above $2.7K would hint at a real trend shift.
🧾 TL;DR
ETH pumped because:
✅ Hit major demand zone
✅ Liquidity sweep below support
✅ Oversold technical bounce
✅ Short liquidations
✅ BTC stabilization helped alts
But…
🚨 No macro breakout yet. This is strength — not confirmation.
Markets move on liquidity, not emotion. Stay sharp. 👀📈
